content.text: The switches apply at once; the shadow rules the next time you start the game.

content.help: Off draws the shadows exactly as the game does, the same as pressing F10.
The near shadow cascade updates every frame, the middle one every second frame and the far one every fourth. Off redraws every cascade every frame.
A cascade that keeps its shadow map this frame also skips gathering its shadow casters. Needs staggered cascades.
Gathers the sun's shadow casters on a separate thread while the main thread draws the scene. Outdoors with precombined visibility only.

content.text: Optional rules from Skyrim Performance Solution. They remove shadows for little gain on top of the staggered cascades, so they are off by default.

content.help: Small objects far away stop casting sun shadows. Never in the nearest cascade or with a low sun. Takes effect the next time you start the game.
Characters and creatures beyond about 50 m cast no shadows. Not with a low sun. Takes effect the next time you start the game.
Small objects far from a lamp stop casting its shadow, outdoors only. Takes effect the next time you start the game.

content.text: Leave small objects out of the rain map
content.help: Rain or snow can then fall through small roofs. Takes effect the next time you start the game.
Fallout 4 VR only: a cascade your head moved or turned away from joins the game's next refit, so far shadows catch up sooner.
